Full summary: Fixed field-reported stop-hook loop and two adjacent losses (#43/#44/#45): marker-based stop gate (plugin 1.16.0), gitignore reconcile for existing stores, dead-letter queue for pending drain. 1221 tests green.
Decisions: [object Object]; Chose bash-regex session_id extraction with strict filename sanitization (allowlist + leading-dot strip) mirrored in both hook scripts — the two scripts must derive identical marker filenames; sanitization prevents path traversal from hostile hook input.; Chose additive-only gitignore reconcile at startup for #44 (append missing canonical entries, never touch user lines) with git rm --cached documented rather than automated — the server must not mutate the user's git index.; Chose dead-letter files (pending-*.dead.jsonl with raw line + error + timestamp) over in-file retry counters for #45 — a poison line retried forever spams logs, while a dead-letter is inspectable and re-queueable by hand; if the dead-letter write itself fails the swap file is left for a future drain instead of deleted with unprocessed lines.
Findings: Field claim 'pending-posts only drains on startup' is stale: the 60s periodic drain shipped in v1.24.0 and is in 2.0.0. Their stuck entries are explained by drain-loss (invalid entry_type → dropped, now #45-fixed) or by hooks writing to a worktree-local .twining that no server drains — the worktree-orphan hypothesis needs field confirmation (noted on #45).; warning: hook/server version skew flagged by the field is real but currently benign — the sentinel (.last-record) is the only cross-artifact contract (plugin hooks read it, npm server writes it); the new .sessions/ marker was deliberately kept plugin-internal to avoid widening that surface. Any future change to sentinel semantics must consider both artifacts' release cadences.; The field's 110 no-op records were caused by the false-block loop itself (the 'post a terse no-op' mitigation); fixing #43 stops the source — existing pollution is dedupable/archivable by housekeeping, no dedicated cleanup shipped.; need: dogfooding note — this repo's installed plugin cache still runs 1.15.0 hooks until the plugin updates; the 1.16.0 marker-based stop hook takes effect in new sessions after the plugin cache refreshes.
